#cloud-config

# Update package index, but avoid full upgrade to prevent delays
package_update: true
package_upgrade: false

# Define groups and users
groups:
  - docker
users:
  - default
  - name: ubuntu
    groups: docker
    lock_passwd: true  # Disable password login for security

# Install required packages (apt-transport-https for Docker repo)
packages:
  - apt-transport-https
  - ca-certificates
  - curl
  - gnupg
  - lsb-release

# Run commands to set up Docker and test the setup
runcmd:
  # Add Docker's official GPG key
  - curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/docker-archive-keyring.gpg || echo "Failed to add Docker GPG key" >> /var/log/cloud-init-error.log

  # Add Docker's official repository
  - echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/docker-archive-keyring.gpg] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu $(lsb_release -cs) stable" | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/null || echo "Failed to add Docker repo" >> /var/log/cloud-init-error.log

  # Update package index again after adding Docker repo
  - apt-get update || echo "Failed to update apt after adding Docker repo" >> /var/log/cloud-init-error.log

  # Install Docker CE and related tools
  - apt-get install -y docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io || echo "Failed to install Docker" >> /var/log/cloud-init-error.log

  # Ensure Docker service is started and enabled
  - systemctl start docker || echo "Failed to start Docker" >> /var/log/cloud-init-error.log
  - systemctl enable docker || echo "Failed to enable Docker" >> /var/log/cloud-init-error.log

  # Pull Nginx image to test Docker Hub connectivity
  - docker pull nginx || echo "Failed to pull Nginx image" >> /var/log/cloud-init-error.log

  # Run Nginx container in detached mode, mapping port 80
  - docker run -d -p 80:80 --name nginx-test nginx || echo "Failed to run Nginx container" >> /var/log/cloud-init-error.log

  # Test outbound internet connectivity
  - curl -v https://google.com || echo "Failed to curl Google" >> /var/log/cloud-init-error.log

  # Log success for debugging
  - echo "Cloud-init completed successfully" >> /var/log/cloud-init-output.log
